name: native_font_wait

ownership.argument: Borrowed exact initialized VG_LITE draw unit, serialized UI owner outside active/queued CPU drawing. May block; never under IRQ lock.
ownership.return_value: Return register is incidental, never a status. Invokes native lower GPU finish and synchronously drains both pending arrays for gradient/image/glyph releases before returning. Native CPU reference retirement is distinct from successful GPU completion; firmware drains even after errors and reset recovery is unproven.

provenance.source: Exact .179 IDA/Hex-Rays inspection and independently rehashed full raw AP function body; assertion lv_vg_lite_utils.c:1435 lv_vg_lite_finish; drains pending arrays at vg_unit+36/+40(+8)/+48 and clears +52; called by the reviewed font_reload_vg_dispatch 0x0c391354 no-task branch. docs/native-ui-font-lifecycle-abi.md.

notes: New native UI font integration identity only. No device verification. Return register is incidental, never a status. Invokes native lower GPU finish and synchronously drains both pending arrays for gradient/image/glyph releases before returning. Native CPU reference retirement is distinct from successful GPU completion; firmware drains even after errors and reset recovery is unproven.
